branchPolicy.workingRule: Use short-lived work-packet branches. Merge a database-verified bounded slice to main before starting the next substantial slice when its evidence boundary is explicit.
branchPolicy.analysisRule: LLMs must use branch.topology.json plus live GitHub compare results before merge/delete/revival decisions.

forbiddenVolatileMarkers: uncited claims that a whole work packet is complete

requirementAlignment.rule: Technical design is LLM-owned inside confirmed business outcomes; future-use-only complexity defaults to deferred.

alignmentCadence.rule: Perform a formal requirement-alignment review after every 3 merged DATABASE E2E VERIFIED/CERTIFIED bounded slices since the last review, or immediately when any mandatory trigger fires, whichever comes first.

currentUnmergedWork.businessOutcome: Existing historical customer payment facts remain reconstructable after cash.received becomes the canonical new receipt path.
currentUnmergedWork.productOutcome: An upgrade does not rewrite or break historical customer-payment records or their realized FX result.
currentUnmergedWork.antiOverdesignDecision: Compatibility-only proof; no generic payment framework and no retroactive cash posting for old facts.
